User.title: User
User.description: Application user profile with role-based access control and active status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Full display name of the recruiter or admin.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

role.description: RBAC role governing row-level isolation vs. master database access.

isActive.description: Whether the account is active and allowed to access the system.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was last modified.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: Nine-column recruitment candidate submission record with strict recruiter ownership metadata.

submissionDate.description: Column 1: Submission date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

managerName.description: Column 2: Hiring or account manager name.

recruiterName.description: Column 3: Recruiter display name (locked to profile for recruiters, editable by admins).

purpose.description: Column 5: Recruitment purpose or pipeline stage.

candidateName.description: Column 6: Candidate full name containing letters and spaces only.

city.description: Column 8: Name of the city where the store or warehouse is located.

resumeUrl.description: Column 9: Optional HTTPS resume download URL or external link.

resumeFileName.description: Optional filename for uploaded resume file.

resumeStoragePath.description: Optional Firebase Storage path for uploaded resume.

recruiter_uid.description: Owner recruiter UID enforced by Firestore Security Rules.

recruiter_email.description: Owner recruiter email attached at submission time.

createdAt.description: System server timestamp when the submission was recorded.

updatedAt.description: System server timestamp when the submission was last edited.

ManagerOption.title: ManagerOption
ManagerOption.description: Admin-managed Manager Name dropdown option for the candidate Data Entry Form.

name.description: Display name of the hiring or account manager.

isActive.description: Whether this manager option is active in the Data Entry Form dropdown.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the option was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the option was last updated.

ClientOption.title: ClientOption
ClientOption.description: Admin-managed Client Name dropdown option for the candidate Data Entry Form.

name.description: Display name of the client company.

isActive.description: Whether this client option is active in the Data Entry Form dropdown.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the option was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the option was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles storing uid, name, email, role (recruiter/admin), and isActive status.

/candidates/{candidateId}.description: Candidate tracking records isolated per recruiter_uid for recruiters and merged for admins.

/managers/{managerId}.description: Admin-managed list of Manager Names shown in the Data Entry Form dropdown.

/clients/{clientId}.description: Admin-managed list of Client Names shown in the Data Entry Form dropdown.
